body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier note about payer cohorts for {Brand} on US UA. A fresh read: now that Honkai: Star Rail has crossed $2bn on mobile with the US at only 13% of its revenue, the US payer is the contested seat in gacha RPG, and it is an expensive one. Hardcore RPG CPI sits near $6.00 on iOS and $4.50 on Android in 2026, so a wasted install hurts. That is exactly where value-based optimization on the first IAP earns its keep. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
